name: prompt-master
description: Promote master: one click rewrites the rough prompt in your prompt box into a clearer one before you send it.

model.title: Rewrite model
model.description: Model that rewrites the prompt when the chat is not used as context (or there is no chat yet).

useConversation.title: Use this chat as context
useConversation.description: Let the rewrite read the current conversation so vague words like 'it' or 'that file' become specific. Uses the session's own model.
